generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The test cases for `ToLowerTests#supplier` and `ToUpperTests#supplier` have been updated to reflect the new `ChangeCaseEvaluator`. Ensure that these tests still cover all necessary scenarios, especially since the evaluator class has changed.

review_comment: As an alternative to avoid the pattern matching, use `Strings.deleteAny(input, " ")` or `Strings.replace(input, " ", "")`
The `\s` class will match more (`[ \t\n\x0B\f\r]`). I use it to compare (multiline, "randomly" spaced) JSONs.
